INTRODUCTION

This manual presents all the operations carried out in a workshop after the disassembly of the passen-
ger seats of the EMB-120 "BRASILIA" aircraft. It allows a technician not acquainted with the equipment
to restore it to its operational conditions.

This manual contains the component description and operation, detailed instructions for disassembling,
checking, repairing and reassembling the component, and an illustrated parts list.

All the procedures described in this manual have been performed by the manufacturer prior to its release
to the users.

The methods presented herein, especially those concerning repairs, must not be modified or extended
to other cases without prior authorization granted by the aviation authorities and the manufacturer.

DESCRIPTION AND OPERATION
1. General
The passenger seats are arranged into two rows in the aircraft, one comprising single seats and
another comprising double seats. In some configurations, the last row may also comprise triple
seats.
2. Description
A. The Single Passenger Seat (Figure 1) configurations listed below may be found on the "EMB-
120" Brasilia:
(1) First row single passenger seat with plug-in type snack table.
(2) Complete Single Passenger Seat with two armrests and snack folding table.
(3) Single Passenger Seat without armrest on the wall side (emergency exit position).
(4) Single Passenger Seat without snack folding table (last row).
(5) Single Passenger Seat with longer armrest, without snack folding table, to fit the triple pas-
senger seat row.
B. The Double Passenger Seat (Figure 2) may be found in the following configurations:
(1) First row Double Passenger Seat with plug-in type snack table.
(2) Complete Double Passenger Seat with armrests and snack folding table.
(3) Double Passenger Seat without armrest on the wall side (emergency exit position).
(4) Double Passenger Seat without snack folding table (last row).
C. There is only one configuration for the Triple Passenger Seat (Figure 3), with three armrests and
without snack folding table.
D. The composite structure of the seat supports the armrests, the backrest and the snack folding
table. The legs are mechanically attached to the seat structure.
E. The center and aisle armrests consist of a composite structure covered with thermoplastic mate-

(b) Mark the area to receive the repair layers with adhesive tape, leaving 1-in (25-mm) mar-

gin for the additional layer to settle.

(c) Lightly sand the surface within the marked area, so as to achieve a good adhesion.

(d) Remove the adhesive tape and clean surface with MEK (Methil Ethil Ketone), at least

D. Replacement of plies.

(1) Use glass fabric preimpregnated with epoxy resin style 7781.

NOTE: Use an additional repair ply (the same fabric as that originally used in the top ply in
the case of hybrid composites) so as to minimize the surface depression when plies
are replaced.

(2) Cut replacement plies to required dimensions. There should be a 1 in (25 mm) overlap.

(3) Manually impregnate fabrics using epoxy resin (Table 2 of SRM chapter 51-70-01, lamination
epoxy resin A, B, C, or D).

(4) Laminate first ply in the position in which it will be saturated with resin. Repeat the procedure
for every ply. The repair plies must be installed in the same sequence as that of the original

(1) Place a thermocouple in the interface between repair area and remaining structure.

(2) Place perforated parting film and bleeder cloth layers, interspersed in the repair as follows:
install one layer of perforated parking film and one layer of bleeder cloth for two plies of
repair fabric.

ASSEMBLY
1. Tools Required
A. Tools commonly used by the technician.
2. Assembly
A. Seat Belt (60) of Single Seat Assembly (detail D of figure 1 of the Illustrated Parts List).
(1) Attach the seat belt (60) to the seat structure by installing bolts (110 and 120), bushing (100),
washers (70 and 80), and nut (90).
B. Seat Belt (80) of Double Seat Assembly (detail A of figure 29 of the Illustrated Parts List).
(1) On the boards:
(a) Attach the seat belt (80) to the seat structure by installing bolts (120 and 125), bushing
(100), washers (110 and 115), and nut (90).
(2) Between seats:
(a) Attach the seat belt (80) to the seat structure by installing the bolt (130), two bushings
(100), two washers (115), and nut (90).
C. Seat Belt (80) of Triple Seat Assembly (detail B of figure 76 of the Illustrated Parts List).
(1) On the boards:
(a) Attach the seat belt (80) to the seat structure by installing bolts (90 and 110), bushing
(140), washer (120), and nut (150).
(2) Between seats:
(a) Attach the seat belt (80) to the seat structure by installing the bolt (100), bushing (140),
washer (130), and nut (150).
D. Life Jacket Stowage (130) Assembly (detail C of figure 1 of the Illustrated Parts List).
(1) Position the Life Jacket Stowage (130) in place and press its four male fastener buttons
(150) into the support (140).
E. Seat Bottom (20) Installation (figure 1 of the Illustrated Parts List).
(1) Position the Seat Bottom (20) and press its Velcro fastener.
EFFECTIVITY: ALL

F. Seat Backrest (30) Installation (figure 1 of the Illustrated Parts List).
(1) Position the Seat Backrest Lining (30) and press its Velcro fastener.
(2) Attach the Snack Table Cover Latch (250) by installing its three attaching screws (270).
(3) Position the Magazine Holder (200) by pressing its two attaching male fastener buttons and
the Velcro fastener.
G. Section PVC (160) Assembly (figure 1 of the Illustrated Parts List).
(1) Position the PVC section (160) and attach it by installing the screw (190), washer (170), and
nut (180).
H. Fixed Armrest Assembly (detail A of figure 1 of the Illustrated Parts List).
(1) Position the front trim cover (240) and attach it by installing the screw (270).
(2) Position the ashtray (210) into the front trim cover (240).
(3) Position the seat armrest lining assembly (220) and attach it by installing its washer (280),
screw (270), and nylon plug (260).
(4) Position the rear trim cover (230) and attach it by installing its screw (270).
J. Movable Armrest Assembly (detail B of figure 29 of the Illustrated Parts List).
(1) Position the front trim cover (250) and attach it by installing the screw (280).
(2) Position the ashtray (210) into the front trim cover (250).
(3) Position the seat armrest lining assembly (220) and attach it by installing its washer (290),
screw (280), and nylon plug (270).
(4) Position the front trim cover (240) and attach it by installing its screw (280).
K. Lateral Trim Cover Assembly - only for seats without armrest on the sidewall (figure 2 of the Illus-
trated Parts List).
(1) Position the lateral trim cover (250) and attach it by installing its screw (280).
L. Armrests (200) of the Single Seat Installation (detail E of figure 79 of the Illustrated Parts List).
(1) Position the armrest (200) in the seat structure and install the screw (210) and nut (220).
